mechanism: Nafcillin may induce metabolism of valganciclovir's active metabolite (ganciclovir) through CYP3A4 induction, potentially reducing antiviral efficacy; concurrent use also increases risk of hematologic toxicity and nephrotoxicity.
action: Monitor for reduced valganciclovir efficacy and increased hematologic/renal toxicity; consider therapeutic drug monitoring of ganciclovir levels and renal function; use alternative beta-lactam if possible or adjust valganciclovir dosing based on clinical response.
